description:
We are building a hardware-in-the-loop navigation and simulation system for the Lunar Landing Site Navigator challenge. 

We focuses on evaluating Direct-to-Earth (DTE) communication windows and solar power generation potential for lunar south pole landing sites (like Shackleton Crater). We combine Python-based JPL ephemeris data modeling with an interactive, physical pan-tilt hardware prototype (microcontroller, servos, and light/solar sensors) to dynamically simulate solar tracking and signal.
